content:
Discord鏈接已修復

Pixelmon Factory是一個不斷進化的模組，專注於整合Create和Pixelmon的體驗，以擴增精靈寶可夢物品的 Crafting 和自動化功能。目前，該模組引入了多種自訂配方、流體和物品強化，以支援獨特的Pixelmon製作工作流程。由於仍處於早期開發階段，模組缺乏大量預期的內容，許多功能仍在精細調整中。玩家的反饋有助於塑造未來的更新並擴增模組的功能。

All assets that have been used are retextures or made by me.

If you have ANY suggestions of features you would like to see in the mod please let me know here.

 

Permissions & Licences:

Create Wrench: From Create (If the owners of Create would like me to remove it, then please message me.)

Pokeball: From IconDuck

 

More description will be added later.
